request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:GUARD

layers.text: Recolour the tan and brown skin of the animal (head, legs, tail and belly) to a clear cornflower blue with navy blue shading, so nothing is tan or brown. Make the red blanket strip over the shell twice as wide, plain bright red, and paint the round ball of the tail club plain bright red. Change nothing else: keep the blue-grey shell plates, the cream spikes, horns and claws, the pose, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
